main.description: A cross-domain system-of-systems leverage point (要 / 律速段階) computed on read from the multilayer graph. The 要 is a STRUCTURAL POSITION, never a natural person (G1). Leverage = C·(V/D)·(1+B)·(1−open); this record is a DERIVED readout (transient), not stored ground state (N1/G4).

target.description: structural-position id (e.g. kaname.if.accred). NEVER a natural person (G1).

kind.description: structural kind; :sos/role is a PUBLIC office, never a private profile.

concentration.description: C — Σ inbound 取-load across domains (×1000, fixed-point)

versatility.description: V — # distinct domains the position bears load in (the SoS discriminator)

bridge.description: B — incident inter-layer connective load (betweenness proxy, ×1000)

leverage.description: L = C·(V/D)·(1+B)·(1−open), ×1000. argmax over the graph = the 要.

domains.description: domain layers this position bears load in

open.description: already-open / decentralized — if true, leverage is 0 (nothing to dissolve)

computedOnRead.description: N1/G4 — this is a transient integral of incident 縁, NOT stored ground state

isTargetList.description: G1 — a leverage MAP is never a target-list; this record names a structural position only
